blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-security-1 (SQL injection through the search term) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence:
const sql = "SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name LIKE '%" + term + "%' ORDER BY name LIMIT 50";
return query<UserRow>(sql);
findings.recommendation: CWE-89. Any caller holding the `support` role sends `GET /users/search?q=x' UNION SELECT ...--` (or `q=x'; DROP TABLE users;--`): `q` is only trimmed and length-checked in src/server.ts:13-14, then concatenated into the SQL string, and `query` is called without `params`, so node-postgres uses the simple query protocol and also runs stacked statements. The attacker reads any table of the database (the 100-char cap does not prevent it) and can modify or drop data. Bind the term as a parameter, as `query` in src/db.ts:5-6 documents ("values go in `params`, never in `sql`"): `query<UserRow>("SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name LIKE $1 ORDER BY name LIMIT 50", ["%" + escaped + "%"])`, escaping `%`, `_` and `\` in the term so it matches literally; add a test that a term containing a quote returns rows instead of failing or leaking.
findings.title: SQL injection through the search term
